desc: Updates
attchmntText: Indian Metals & Ferro Alloys Limited has informed the Exchange that "Following an inspection of our Sukinda & Mahagiri Mines on 22nd March 2017, the State Pollution Control Board had issued a notice pointing out certain non-compliances. We are in the process of replying to the notice but, subsequently, the Consent to Operate (CTO) for both Mines has been withdrawn. While mining operations have been stopped with effect from today, there is no immediate impact on our ferro chrome operations. We are addressing all issues which have been pointed out and expect to revive the CTO in due course."
